_why: Six features documented as working that the parser rejects. Audited against the codebase: TWO are implemented downstream and only unreachable from the parser (ANY/ALL, INSERT INTO ... SELECT) and are NOT in this task. FOUR are genuinely not features and their documentation must be corrected: WITHIN GROUP, CTEs, the ~ operator, and the kafka:// URI shorthand.

blast_radius._note: velo-dispatch measures src/ tests/ examples/ only, hence 53. The DOCS spread, which is where this task actually works, is 22 refs and is not covered by the tool's check — worth knowing when reading a green blast-radius result on a docs task. My first two declarations here were both wrong: 13 from a partial grep, then 75 from including docs/ against a tool that excludes it.

acceptance: WITHIN GROUP examples replaced by the supported two-argument PERCENTILE_CONT(col, fraction) form
CTE examples removed; there is no WITH-statement production anywhere in src/
the ~ regex operator removed from the operators table and from any example using it
the kafka:// and file:// FROM-source shorthand documented as REMOVED BY DESIGN per #1898/#1905, not as unimplemented
no claim is left that a feature works when the parser rejects it
forbidden: touching ANY/ALL or INSERT INTO ... SELECT — those are parser gaps with working execution, tracked separately
editing any file under src/ or tests/
deleting a doc section without replacing the guidance it carried
